name: Inbox mail
description: Watch up to five mailboxes over IMAP and put only what matters in the notification centre: one alert for a message from an important sender, matching your keywords or marked urgent, and one rolling digest per account for the rest. An Inbox panel shows all accounts together, opens a message body only when you click it and changes read or star state only when you click that. No model calls.
author: minih-git

en.name: Inbox mail
en.description: Watch up to five mailboxes over IMAP and put only what matters in the notification centre: one alert for a message from an important sender, matching your keywords or marked urgent, and one rolling digest per account for the rest. An Inbox panel shows all accounts together, opens a message body only when you click it and changes read or star state only when you click that. No model calls.
en.safetyNotes: Reads up to five mailboxes you choose in Settings, over IMAP with implicit TLS, and nothing else. The app performs every sign-in itself: your password or authorization code stays in the app's credential store and is never handed to this plugin, which only learns which accounts exist, their labels, the email address you typed as a label and whether an account is filled. Each account keeps one IDLE connection plus a 15-minute fallback poll, and the panel reuses that connection for the work it triggers, so the plugin stays inside the host's ceiling of eight TCP connections. While watching, it selects the inbox and for a new message fetches only envelope fields and a few headers (sender, subject, date, Message-ID, urgency flags) with BODY.PEEK, which does not mark anything as read. A message body is downloaded only when you open that message in the Inbox panel, one message at a time, capped at 1 MiB (a larger one is truncated and the panel says so), kept in memory for the panel to show and never written to disk; attachments are listed by file name and size and are never downloaded. In its own data folder it keeps one small file: per account the UIDVALIDITY number, the highest UID already handled, the Message-IDs already reported (at most 200), the digest queue, the last error, and the envelope of the newest 200 messages (sender, subject, date, flags) — no message text. Read and star state changes only when you click mark read/unread or add/remove the star in the panel, and such a click sends exactly one IMAP STORE of the Seen flag or the Flagged flag on that one message; nothing changes read or star state on its own. An HTML body is sanitized and displayed in a scriptless, origin-less sandboxed frame that loads nothing remote: remote images stay blocked until you press "show remote images" for that one message, and links are opened by the app in your browser instead of inside the panel. Notifications carry the sender, the subject, the time and the account, never the body. It does not send mail, create drafts, delete, move, copy or archive messages, and it uploads nothing: the only network destination is the IMAP server of the provider each account is set to. No model is called at any point, so nothing you receive is sent to an AI provider.

zh-CN.name: 邮箱收件
zh-CN.description: 在后台盯住最多 5 个 IMAP 邮箱，只把该看的邮件放进通知中心：重要发件人、关键词命中或标记紧急的邮件各发一条提醒，其余按账号合并成一条滚动汇总。侧栏「收件箱」面板把所有账号放在一起，只有你点开某封邮件才取正文，也只有你亲手点击才会改变已读和星标。不调用模型。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只读你在设置里选择的、最多 5 个邮箱，别的一概不碰，一律使用隐式 TLS 的 IMAP。登录由应用自己完成：密码或授权码留在应用的凭据库里，不会交给插件；插件只知道有哪些账号、账号标签、你填的邮箱地址，以及某个账号是否已填写。每个账号保持一条 IDLE 长连接，另有 15 分钟一次的兜底轮询；面板触发的操作复用这条已有连接，所以本插件不会超过宿主给单个插件规定的 8 条 TCP 连接。在协议上只选中收件箱，新邮件只取信封字段和少量头部（发件人、主题、时间、Message-ID、紧急标记），一律使用 BODY.PEEK，不会把邮件标为已读。只有你在「收件箱」面板里点开某封邮件时，才会下载那一封的正文，一次一封，上限 1 MiB（更大的会截断，面板会说明）；正文只在内存里交给面板显示，绝不写盘；附件只列出文件名和大小，从不下载。插件自己的数据目录里只有一个小文件：按账号保存 UIDVALIDITY、已处理的最大 UID、已提醒过的 Message-ID（最多 200 条）、汇总队列、最近一次错误，以及每个账号最近 200 封邮件的信封（发件人、主题、时间、标记），不保存任何邮件正文。已读与星标状态只在你点击「标为已读」「标为未读」「加星标」「取消星标」时改变，一次点击只对那一封邮件发一条 IMAP STORE（写入已读标记或星标标记），插件不会自行更改任何邮件的已读或星标。HTML 正文经清洗后放进一个无脚本、无同源权限的隔离框中显示，且不加载任何远程资源：远程图片默认拦截，只有你为当前这封邮件点「显示远程图片」才放行；链接不在面板内打开，点击后由应用在你的浏览器中打开。通知里只有发件人、主题、时间和账号，没有正文。不发信、不写草稿、不删除/移动/复制/归档邮件，也不上传任何东西：唯一的网络目的地是你为每个账号选定的服务商 IMAP 服务器。全程不调用模型，收到的邮件不会被发送给任何 AI 服务商。

label.en: IMAP authorization code or app password
label.zh-CN: IMAP 授权码或应用专用密码

description.en: One per line or comma-separated: a full address (boss@example.com), a domain (@example.com) or a word that appears in the sender's name. A message from one of them gets its own alert.
description.zh-CN: 每行一个，或用逗号分隔：完整地址（boss@example.com）、域名（@example.com），或发件人名字里的一个词。来自这些人的邮件各发一条提醒。

description.en: One per line or comma-separated. A new message whose subject or sender name contains one of them gets its own alert.
description.zh-CN: 每行一个，或用逗号分隔。新邮件的主题或发件人名字包含其中任一个，就单独发一条提醒。

description.en: How long the rest of the new mail is collected before it becomes one digest entry per account. A single entry is updated instead of added again.
description.zh-CN: 其余新邮件收集多久后，按账号各自合成一条汇总。同一条汇总会被更新，而不会反复新增。

description.en: When on, messages that are already read in the mailbox are ignored, which keeps a second device's reading from producing alerts.
description.zh-CN: 开启后，邮箱里已经是已读的邮件会被忽略，这样在别的设备上读过的邮件不会再提醒。
